site.name: Pixcel Studio
site.subheading: A graphic design studio working across branding, packaging and social media — for founders who want their work to look like it means it.

services.title: Branding
services.description: Identity systems built from the inside out — strategy, naming support, logo, colour, type and the guidelines to keep it consistent as you grow.

services.title: Packaging
services.description: Structural and print-ready packaging design that holds up on a crowded shelf and photographs even better on a phone screen.

services.title: Social Media Creatives
services.description: Templated, on-brand creative systems for feeds, stories and ads — built so your team can keep posting long after we hand it over.

works.description: A coffee packaging system built around single-origin storytelling — six SKUs, one shelf presence.
Full identity relaunch for a clinical skincare line, from wordmark to unboxing.
A flexible Instagram template system that grew engagement without growing the design team.
Identity and signage for an independent pottery studio, warm and hand-built by design.
Cold-pressed juice bottles designed to read clearly from three metres away.
Launch campaign creative across Reels, stories and paid social for a plant-care brand.

testimonials.quote: Pixcel didn't just design a logo, they gave us a whole language for the brand. Every packaging decision since has been easy because the system already knows what it wants to say.
testimonials.name: Ayesha Rahman

testimonials.quote: We handed them a half-formed idea and three competitor screenshots. They came back with something none of us had thought of and it was obviously right.
testimonials.name: Devan Mehta

testimonials.quote: The social templates are the first design system our marketing team has actually kept using six months later. That's the real test.
testimonials.name: Priya Nambiar
